title: Kaiser nurses say AI, surveillance are making their jobs and patient care worse
summary: Nurses at Kaiser Permanente report that AI tools and workplace surveillance systems are negatively impacting their work quality and patient care, citing concerns about increased monitoring, reduced autonomy, and potential risks to patient safety.
problem_solved: Highlights the unintended negative consequences of AI and surveillance technology adoption in healthcare settings from frontline workers' perspective.
why_valuable: Provides essential worker-level insights into the real-world challenges of AI implementation in healthcare, serving as a cautionary case study for organizations deploying similar technologies.
